title: jams engine scene, format v1

$schema.description: Path or URI of this file's JSON Schema, for editors. Ignored by the engine.

v.description: Scene format version. Files are migrated up on load and always saved at the current version.

name.description: Scene name, same rules as an id; matches the file name without .json.
name.title: Name

bounds.description: World rectangle [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in px; y is down. Limits the camera and where the Shaper can build.
bounds.title: Bounds

spawn.description: Player spawn points: each is the player's FEET, so put it on a floor's top edge. One per player; spawns 60px apart or more.
spawn.title: Spawns

solid.description: Static ground shapes, absolute px. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~<key>:<index>.

solid:ice.description: Static ice shapes: low friction, the player slides. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~<key>:<index>.

solid:chocolate.description: Static chocolate shapes: slow the player. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~<key>:<index>.

solid:trampoline.description: Static trampoline shapes: bounce the player up. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~<key>:<index>.

cloud.description: One-way cloud platforms, box only, absolute px. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~<key>:<index>.

anchor.description: Grapple anchor points, absolute px. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~anchor:<index>.

entities.description: Entities with stable ids: anything that moves, has parameters, or is referenced.

description: A jams engine scene. Units are integer pixels with y pointing down. Simple static geometry lives in the bulk arrays; everything else is an entity.

Pt.description: A point [x, y] in integer world pixels; y is down.

ShapeTuple.description: A shape tuple: ["box", cx, cy, hw, hh, rotDeg?] | ["circle", cx, cy, r] | ["capsule", cx, cy, halfLen, r, rotDeg?] | ["poly", x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, ...] | ["chain", x1, y1, x2, y2, ...]. Integer pixels, y is down.

oneOf.title: box
oneOf.description: Axis-aligned box (a Rapier cuboid) by centre and half-extents, optionally rotated about its centre.

prefixItems.description: Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: circle
oneOf.description: Circle (a Rapier ball) by centre and radius.

oneOf.title: capsule
oneOf.description: Capsule, vertical before rotation: a segment of half-length halfLen through the centre, swept by radius r.

prefixItems.description: Half the length of the inner segment.
Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: poly
oneOf.description: Convex polygon as flat x, y pairs (at least 3 points). Points are absolute; the loader centres the body on their centroid. Concave outlines must be split or drawn as a chain.

oneOf.title: chain
oneOf.description: Open polyline as flat x, y pairs (at least 2 points), for static terrain. Allowed on solid and sensor only.

BoxShape.description: A shape tuple: ["box", cx, cy, hw, hh, rotDeg?]. Integer pixels, y is down.

oneOf.title: box
oneOf.description: Axis-aligned box (a Rapier cuboid) by centre and half-extents, optionally rotated about its centre.

prefixItems.description: Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

id.description: Stable id, unique in the scene: lowercase letters, digits and '-', 1-48 characters, starting with a letter or digit. Ops and other entities refer to the entity by it.
id.title: Id

name.description: Display label for the editor's outliner. No runtime effect.
name.title: Name

layer.description: Editor layer, for showing, hiding and locking groups of entities. No runtime effect.
layer.title: Layer

group.description: Editor group name; entities sharing it select and move together. No runtime effect.
group.title: Group

off.description: When true the entity stays in the file but is not loaded, e.g. to A/B a jump without deleting it.
off.title: Disabled

b.description: Static ground: the player stands on it and collides from every side.

shape.description: Collider shape. Absolute world px; y is down. Any tag, including chain for terrain outlines.

material.title: Material
